Print a nadir_sl_model

Source: R/nadir_sl_model_methods.R, R/super_learner.R
nadir_sl_model_methods.Rd

Summarises the model inputs (outcome, outcome type, number of observations and cross-validation folds) and outputs (ensemble weights), plus any errors captured during training.

Combines the ensemble weights with each candidate learner's cross-validated held-out loss, using the loss appropriate to the model's outcome_type (mean squared error for continuous outcomes; negative log loss for binary, multiclass, and density outcomes).

Following the convention of coef.SuperLearner in the SuperLearner package, the "coefficients" of a super learner are the meta-learned ensemble weights on the candidate learners.

Returns the ensemble's cross-validated predictions on the held-out folds: each value is the learner-weighted prediction for an observation, produced by learners trained without that observation. These are honest (out-of-fold) rather than in-sample fitted values.

Observed outcomes minus the cross-validated ensemble predictions of fitted.nadir_sl_model. I.e., honest out-of-fold residuals. See that function's documentation for the row-ordering convention.

Returns the regression formula shared by all learners when a single formula was used, and otherwise the named list of per-learner formulas.

If the model was fit with train_on_whole_dataset = FALSE, no whole-dataset learner fits exist and this method errors with a message directing users to the out-of-fold prediction interfaces ($oof_predictions, $oof_predict(), $oof_predict_modified(), $oof_predict_fold()).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
coef(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
fitted(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
residuals(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
formula(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
nobs(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'nadir_sl_model'
predict(object, newdata, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class nadir_sl_model.

digits

Number of digits for the printed weights.

...

Ellipses, solely provided so that the predict.nadir_sl_model method is compatible with the generic predict, which takes ellipses as an argument.

object

An object of class inheriting from nadir_sl_model.

newdata

A tabular data structure (data.frame or matrix) of predictor variables.

Value

x, invisibly.

An object of class summary.nadir_sl_model: a list with a $comparison data.frame (one row per learner: weight and held-out loss, best first) plus $y_variable, $outcome_type, $n_obs, and $n_folds.

A named numeric vector of ensemble weights summing to 1.

A numeric vector of cross-validated ensemble predictions (or, for density/multiclass outcomes, ensemble mixture densities or probabilities of the observed outcomes).

A numeric vector of out-of-fold residuals. Errors for outcome_type = 'density' or 'multiclass', where held-out predictions are not point predictions.

A formula if all learners share one; otherwise a named list of formulas, one per learner.

Integer number of rows of the (complete-case-filtered) training data.

a numeric vector of predicted values

Details

Values are returned in cross-validation fold order, matching the rows of $holdout_predictions (which contains the corresponding observed outcomes), not in the row order of the originally supplied data. For out-of-fold predictions in original row order, use crossfit_super_learner()$oof_predictions.

Examples

sl_fit <- super_learner(mtcars, mpg ~ hp,
  learners = list(lnr_mean, lnr_lm)
)
predict(sl_fit, newdata = mtcars)
